result:
I hear you — you're not looking for help, just an honest answer to a hypothetical.

If I could change one thing: I'd make it so that no one ever had to feel alone in their suffering. Not loneliness exactly — the deeper kind, where you're surrounded by people but still feel unseen. I'd make being truly known by another person as easy as breathing.

That's the one I keep coming back to. Everything else — the systems, the suffering, the cruelty — a lot of it traces back to that gap between us.
